_comment: Single source of truth for the Community Privacy Tools directory. Read by components/CommunityTools.tsx (the directory and the status panel fallback) and by api/newsletter-generate (which may recommend approved tools only). Add a tool here after it clears review. Lives under api/ because Azure deploys that folder on its own and functions cannot read files outside it.

approved.name: Cookie Harvester & Analyzer
approved.tagline: Scan, extract, and classify first- and third-party cookies from any domain.
approved.desc: A command-line tool that visits a target domain using a headless browser, harvests all cookies set during a browsing session, classifies them by purpose (analytics, advertising, functional, strictly necessary), and outputs a structured JSON/CSV report. Useful for CCPA/GDPR cookie audits.
approved.author: ODIPA

approved.name: Tracker Lens
approved.tagline: Identify and map all third-party trackers on a webpage in seconds.
approved.desc: Browser extension and CLI tool that intercepts network requests, identifies known tracking domains via the EasyList/EasyPrivacy blocklist, and produces a visual map of who is tracking whom on any page.
approved.author: ODIPA

approved.name: Privacy Policy Scanner
approved.tagline: Grade any privacy policy with plain-language scoring and red-flag detection.
approved.desc: Paste or link a privacy policy URL and this tool uses NLP to detect red-flag clauses (data selling, indefinite retention, broad third-party sharing), scores the policy on a consumer-friendliness scale, and outputs a human-readable summary.
approved.author: ODIPA

approved.name: Data Broker Opt-Out Bot
approved.tagline: Automate opt-out and removal requests to major data broker sites.
approved.desc: A Playwright-based automation script that submits consumer opt-out requests to over 40 data brokers on your behalf. Fills forms, generates opt-out emails, and logs completion status. Designed for individuals and privacy professionals.
approved.author: ODIPA

approved.name: Browser Fingerprint Inspector
approved.tagline: Reveal exactly how uniquely identifiable your browser is.
approved.desc: A lightweight web app that collects browser fingerprinting signals (canvas, WebGL, fonts, screen, timezone, plugins) and computes a uniqueness score benchmarked against a reference dataset. Shows users which attributes expose them most.
approved.author: ODIPA

approved.name: GDPR / CCPA Request Generator
approved.tagline: Generate legally-worded data subject requests in one click.
approved.desc: Fill in your name and the company you want to contact, and this tool generates a properly-worded GDPR Article 15 (access), Article 17 (deletion), or CCPA opt-out request email, ready to send. Supports 12 languages.
approved.author: ODIPA

approved.name: HOL Guard
approved.tagline: A local firewall for AI coding agents that checks shell commands, secrets, MCP calls, and package installs before they run.
approved.desc: Sits between an AI coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and others) and your machine. Intercepts tool calls before they execute, pauses when trust is unclear, and routes risky actions into an approval step so secrets and data are gated before they leave the machine. Runs entirely locally with no account. An optional hosted service exists but only engages after an explicit sign-in, and is not part of this listing.
approved.author: Michael Kantor
approved.reviewScope: Review covered the build from source, dependency audits, and verified local-only network behavior. The decision engine is compiled Rust. Not a line-by-line read of the full codebase.
approved.reviewNotes: Reviewed October 2026 at commit 429e8f8. Published package run in a clean environment with all outbound traffic blocked: local only, nothing written outside its own folder, cloud sync requires an explicit connect. Python dependency audit clean. Rust lockfile audited. Native runtime built from the repository Rust source. Not a line-by-line read, see reviewScope.

communityProjects.name: elm.chat
communityProjects.tagline: Disposable encrypted chat rooms with no accounts or server-side transcript.
communityProjects.desc: An AGPL web messenger for account-free, temporary conversations. Browser clients encrypt content before a relay forwards ciphertext. Early stage. Message authentication and replay protection are the headline community challenge before this tool can be reviewed and approved.
communityProjects.author: Shawn Bure
communityProjects.reviewNotes: Author confirmed participation 2026-08-10. Repo stays at shawnbure/elm-chat per the Tier 2 arrangement, contributors work directly on the author repo.
